# jobhunt

A job-search copilot: Python does the plumbing, the agent CLI does the judgment. The project
guide (pipeline, data model, hard rules) is `CLAUDE.md`; it applies on every harness. Never
fabricate resume content, never submit an application, zero em-dashes in anything generated.

## Commands

claude, opencode, gemini and pi have native `/jh-*` commands rendered from `prompts/commands/`. On
codex and agy, the user says the text below instead. When a message starts with one of
these names, with or without a leading `/` or `$`, read `prompts/commands/<name>.md` once and
follow it: `$ARGUMENTS` in that file is the rest of the message, and its `tools:` line is what
the flow needs (`bash` is your shell tool).

- `jh-debrief`: Digest an interview transcript into a debrief, prep notes, and answer-bank updates.
- `jh-discover`: Pull fresh jobs from all enabled sources into the local DB
- `jh-followups`: Show applications due for follow-up and draft nudges
- `jh-gmail-sync`: Read every configured mailbox for status signals on open applications; classify, dry-run, apply (auto-apply since 2026-09-04)
- `jh-hunt`: Full job-hunt pipeline end to end under the hunt orchestrator: discover, triage, match, inbox pull, pick the top 5 shortlisted, research + tailor those 5, report.
- `jh-match`: Score newly discovered jobs against your profile, run by the hunt orchestrator
- `jh-prep`: Interview prep brief for a job in screen/interview stage.
- `jh-report`: Generate and open the offline HTML dashboard from the pipeline DB.
- `jh-research <company | job_id>`: Research a company into a reusable, cited dossier.
- `jh-review`: Monthly feedback loop: measure conversion, audit triage, propose profile/rubric tweaks
- `jh-tailor <job_id>`: Tailor resume + cover letter for a job.
- `jh-triage`: Coarse junk-cut of discovered jobs before the expensive matcher, run by the hunt orchestrator
- `jh-upskill [job_id]`: Skill-gap analysis vs the market being applied to; learning plan for real gaps, profile diffs for vocabulary gaps.
